make-parallel-ohm.q: Draw a parallel circuit for a lesson: a 12 V battery with 4, 6 and 12 ohm resistors in parallel, and show the total resistance on the picture.
make-parallel-ohm.reply:
MAKE SCHEMATIC: Parallel Resistors
mode electrical
part V1 battery "12 V"
part R1 resistor "4 ohm"
part R2 resistor "6 ohm"
part R3 resistor "12 ohm"
wire V1 R1
wire R1 V1
wire V1 R2
wire R2 V1
wire V1 R3
wire R3 V1
END

queue-ball.q: Five people stand in a queue, front to back: Ann, Ben, Cal, Dee, Eve. Ben holds a ball. 1. The person at the back moves to the front. 2. The person holding the ball swaps places with the person directly behind them. 3. Whoever holds the ball gives it to the person at the front. 4. The second and fourth people in the queue swap places. What is the order of the queue from front to back, and who holds the ball?
queue-ball.reply:
From my own knowledge:
The initial queue is: Ann (1), Ben (2), Cal (3), Dee (4), Eve (5). Ben holds the ball.
Step 1: The person at the back (Eve) moves to the front.
New order: Eve, Ann, Ben, Cal, Dee. Ball is still with Ben.
Step 2: The person holding the ball (Ben) swaps places with the person directly behind them.
Ben is at position 3. The person behind him is Cal (position 4).
Swap Ben and Cal.
New order: Eve, Ann, Cal, Ben, Dee. Ball is now with Cal.
Step 3: Whoever holds the ball (Cal) gives it to the person at the front (Eve).
Ball moves to Eve.
New order: Eve, Ann, Cal, Ben, Dee. Ball
